svg.title: DrugAssist entity relationship database schema
svg.desc: Purple two-column entity tables with SQL types on the left and fields on the right. Crow's-foot connectors distinguish one, zero or one, and zero or many. Solid links are matching declared SQL foreign keys. Dashed links A and B are application relationships. Three database boundaries remain separate.
svg.text: Entity relationship view | SQL type on the left, field name and constraints on the right
PK = primary key FK = matching declared foreign key UQ = unique NN = explicitly NOT NULL
Active collection: 8,601 passages | 1,536 dimensions | cosine HNSW
Internal update log; vector BLOBs can also be present here.
HNSW index files - not a SQL table
Vectors, graph connections and index bookkeeping.
The embeddings table itself has no vector column.
One user can have zero or more sessions.
sessions.user_id references users.id; ON DELETE CASCADE. Times are Unix seconds.
key: digest of embedding fingerprint + exact text
vector: float32 bytes, validated by application code
No SQL foreign keys between the three databases.
A segments.collection declares REFERENCES collection(id), but the existing table is collections. Its intended link is dashed.
B embeddings.segment_id and the HNSW directory are application-managed links; neither is a matching declared SQL foreign key.
Crow's feet describe valid intended records. Optional parent markers reflect nullable FK fields. Chroma enforcement is not assumed.
Core schema only. Composite keys contain all marked PK columns. See database-schema.md for source mapping and full annotations.
Verified against local schemas on 20 October 2026 | Chroma 1.5.9 | No account rows or secrets shown
